concepts.def: Augustine and Aquinas developed criteria: just cause, last resort, proportionality, just authority, intention of peace.
Refusal to participate in war; Quakers, Mennonites; Christian basis in Matthew 5:9 'blessed are the peacemakers'.
Arabic 'struggle'; greater jihad is inner struggle against sin; lesser jihad is defensive warfare under strict rules.
Conflict justified by religion; Crusades 1095-1291 against Muslims; rejected by mainstream Christianity today.
Nuclear, biological, chemical; religions generally oppose; Vatican II called nuclear war 'crime against God'.
Religious response to conflict; Christian 'turn the other cheek' (Matthew 5:39); restorative not retributive justice.
